requirements.name: Geodetic Coordinates (WGS84, ECEF, Local ENU)
requirements.notes: Double precision f64 math, WGS84 ellipsoid parameters (WGS84_A, WGS84_F) accurately implemented.

requirements.name: Headless Simulation Invariance
requirements.notes: Simulation executes without any display server or GPU device handle.

requirements.name: OpenStreetMap XML Parsing (Roads, Buildings, Landuse)
requirements.notes: Verified against real assets/san_francisco_sample/ and assets/bengaluru_sample/.

requirements.name: GeoTIFF Elevation Raster Extraction
requirements.notes: Bilinear elevation sampling functional; Bengaluru elevation raster ingested accurately.

requirements.name: 38 US City Real GIS Dataset Coverage
requirements.notes: Stage 2 complete for San Francisco Pilot: Authoritative OSM XML and genuine USGS 3DEP DEM binary ingested with SHA-256 provenance and zero procedural hill approximations. Production paths use load_authentic_city. Synthetic generators strictly quarantined to test fixtures.

requirements.name: Manifold Polygon Triangulation (Earcut)
requirements.notes: Triangulates complex polygons with holes; rejects degenerate zero-area triangles.

requirements.name: Grade-Separated Road Crossing Validation
requirements.notes: Enforces layer/bridge height separation; prevents overpass roads from collapsing into planar intersections.

requirements.name: Spatial Chunking & Compressed Packaging
requirements.notes: Chunks world into 500m blocks with zstd compression and SQLite catalog indexing.

requirements.name: Cryptographic Package Integrity (SHA-256)
requirements.notes: Detects chunk corruption, truncated bytes, and tampered header metadata.

requirements.name: Distance-Based Hierarchical LOD (LOD 0-3)
requirements.notes: Hysteresis band prevents rapid thrashing between LOD levels across boundaries.

requirements.name: Asynchronous Chunk Streaming & Memory Budget
requirements.notes: LRU cache unloads distant chunks when memory threshold (default 1024 MB) is exceeded.

requirements.name: Rapier3D Rigid Body World & Terrain Collision
requirements.notes: Fixed 60 Hz substep physics loop; static mesh colliders generated for terrain and buildings.

requirements.name: Drivable Car Physics (Pacejka Tires & Powertrain)
requirements.notes: Torque curves, gear ratios, suspension damping, and 4-wheel normal contact validated.

requirements.name: Multi-Modal Vehicle Physics (Aviation, Marine, Rail)
requirements.notes: Equations for lift/drag, buoyancy, and rail adherence implemented in math structs, but completely disconnected from interactive viewer controls.

requirements.name: Road Network Graph & A* Pathfinding
requirements.notes: Petgraph topology parsed from road centerlines; admissible heuristic guarantees optimal routes.

requirements.name: Autonomous Traffic Simulation
requirements.notes: NPC vehicles follow lane graphs and avoid rear-end collisions; visual representation in 3D viewer uses simplified boxes.

requirements.name: Cross-Platform WGPU Graphics Pipeline
requirements.notes: Supports Vulkan, DirectX 12, and Metal via wgpu; gracefully falls back on missing hardware.

requirements.name: Cascaded Shadow Maps & Atmospheric Scattering
requirements.notes: WGSL world shader incorporates directional solar illumination, sun shadows, and atmospheric color gradients.

requirements.name: Interactive Desktop Windowing & Live Surface
requirements.notes: Winit event loop handles surface recreation, redraw, keyboard/mouse input, and resize events.

requirements.name: Realistic Framerate Metrics vs Headless Spurious FPS
requirements.notes: Headless benchmark reports >3000 FPS due to unthrottled loop without display presentation. Windowed interactive mode is capped by VSync (60 FPS).

requirements.name: Multi-Career Mission Loop (Taxi, Courier, Freight)
requirements.notes: Job acceptance, waypoint navigation, proximity dwell, wallet payout, and XP progression fully integrated.

requirements.name: Game Persistence (Quicksave F5 / Quickload F9)
requirements.notes: Versioned JSON save file preserves player position, career stats, wallet, and settings.

requirements.name: Authoritative Server & Client Prediction Protocol
requirements.notes: Crate implements UDP transport, token bucket rate limiter, interest management, and predictor, but is COMPLETELY DISCONNECTED from world-viewer.

requirements.name: Windows Standalone Zero-Repo Distribution
requirements.notes: Generates real Windows ZIP with executable, bundled pilot world, and SHA256 checksums.

requirements.name: Linux AppDir / AppImage Structure
requirements.notes: AppDir structure and portable tarball created; full AppImage requires appimagetool on host.

requirements.name: macOS Universal .app Bundle
requirements.notes: Valid Info.plist, executable structure, and Metal integration.

requirements.name: Android JNI ABI & Gradle Project
requirements.notes: Gradle project compiles authentic APK/AAB, but nativeSurfaceCreated is a stub flag without ANativeWindow / WGPU surface initialization. Simulation uses FlatGround.

requirements.name: iOS Metal Bridge & UIKit Harness
requirements.notes: Simulator package verified; physical device IPA packaging requires active Apple Developer code-signing certificates.

requirements.name: Continuous Integration Pipeline (ci.yml)
requirements.notes: Enforces formatting, clippy, cargo audit, llvm-cov, desktop matrix, mobile matrix, and ci-success gate.

requirements.name: Automated Security Audit (cargo audit)
requirements.notes: Zero vulnerabilities in Cargo.lock; cargo audit configured with clean deny-warnings.

requirements.name: Release Workflow & Checksum Manifests (release.yml)
requirements.notes: Computes SHA-256 for all distribution artifacts and generates release manifest.

requirements.name: Requirements Traceability & Anti-Fake Governance
requirements.notes: Prior certification declared 100% production ready despite disconnected networking, mobile surface stubs, and synthetic geography across 32 cities. Rectified under Phase 0.

requirements.name: Test Suite Fidelity (Real vs Mock/Assumptions)
requirements.notes: Multiple integration tests assert on internal stub return codes (e.g. nativeSurfaceCreated == 0) rather than real end-to-end behavior.

requirements.name: Final Production Readiness Ratification
requirements.notes: Production release blocked pending remediation of mobile surface rendering, multiplayer viewer integration, real GIS ingestion for 36 cities, and real-world multi-modal vehicle controls.
